Setting.Label: Unboxing Settings
Setting.ModeWaxDesc: Hold to crack the seal and reveal the content.
Setting.ModeDustDesc: Scratch the dust away to uncover hidden text.
Setting.ModePasswordDesc: Enter the correct password to unlock access.
Setting.ModeLockpickDesc: Pick the lock to reveal the content.
Setting.ModeSmashDesc: Smash the object image to reveal the content.
Setting.ModeComboDesc: Crack the combination to unlock the safe.
Setting.ModeMatchingDesc: Match pairs of runes to break the seal.
Setting.ModeMazeDesc: Navigate the circuit maze before time runs out.
Setting.ComboCodeHelp: The correct combination. Each digit (0-9) corresponds to one dial.
Setting.MatchingGridSizeHelp: Total number of rune pairs. More pairs = larger grid = harder puzzle.
Setting.MatchingCardBackHelp: Custom image for the back of all cards.
Setting.MatchingCardFrontHelp: Custom background image for the front of all cards. Symbols are drawn on top.
Setting.MatchingCustomSymbolsHelp: Override default rune symbols. Use image paths, emoji, or text. Leave empty for built-in runes.
Setting.MatchingShowPreviewHelp: Briefly reveal all cards face-up before the game begins, giving players time to memorize.
Setting.MatchingPreviewSecondsHelp: How long all cards stay visible at the start.
Setting.MatchingMaxAttemptsHelp: Maximum number of mismatches allowed before failure. 0 = unlimited.
Setting.MatchingMatchSoundHelp: Played when two cards match. Leave empty for default.
Setting.MatchingMismatchSoundHelp: Played when two cards do not match. Leave empty for default.
Setting.MazeDifficultyHelp: Higher levels generate larger, more complex mazes with more hazards.
Setting.MazeTimeLimitHelp: How many seconds the player has to reach the exit. Default: 30.
Setting.MazeMaxKeysHelp: Maximum number of key/lock pairs that can appear. Actual count is random up to this value.
Setting.MazeAllowRetryHelp: If enabled, players can retry the maze when time runs out instead of failing immediately.
Setting.InteractionRangeHelp: Maximum distance (in grid squares) a player must be within to interact. 0 = unlimited.
Setting.LockpickPinsHelp: Maximum lockpicks before auto-unlock. When all break, the lock opens automatically.
Setting.SmashImagePlaceholder: Leave empty to use the default smash image
Setting.SmashImageHelp: Choose the image shown in smash mode. Crack and particle effects are rendered on top.
Setting.SmashDamageImagesHelp: Optionally provide images for each damage stage. The base image is replaced as damage progresses. Leave empty to use crack overlay effects only.
Setting.SmashDamageImagePlaceholder: Leave empty to keep base image
Setting.SmashHitsHelp: Base number of clicks to break the object. Adjusted by difficulty.
Setting.TextColorWarning: May be overridden by other modules or journal settings.
Setting.GmOnlyConfigHelp: Only the GM can open and edit this page's unboxing settings.
Setting.DustImageHelp: Override the built-in dust texture with a custom image.
Setting.RevealMessageHelp: Use {{name}} for player/character name, {{journal}} for page title. Leave empty for mode default.
Setting.DisableRevealChatHelp: Do not send a chat message when this page is revealed.
Setting.RequiredItemHelp: Drag an item here to require players to have this item in their inventory to unlock the content.
Setting.ItemDescriptionHelp: Used first in item reveal. Leave empty to use the system item description.
Setting.SystemItemDescriptionHelp: This is currently read from the item sheet data (such as DnD5E/PF2E descriptions).
Setting.ItemDescriptionNoSystem: No system description was detected on this item.
Setting.ItemMetaChipsHint: For icons, enter Font Awesome or RPG Awesome classes. Example: fa-solid fa-star / ra ra-sword
Setting.ItemMetaChipsEmpty: No meta chips yet. Use + to add one.
Setting.ItemChipHelp: Leave empty in D&D5E/PF2E to auto-show rarity/type. In other systems, these fields are shown as the chips.
Setting.KeyItemInvalidType: Only items can be used as keys.
Setting.KeyItemNotFound: Could not find the dropped item.
Setting.ConsumeKeyHelp: Delete the key item from player's inventory after successful unlock.
Setting.AutoRevealPermissionHelp: When a player completes the unboxing, their ownership of the parent journal is raised to the selected level.
Setting.AutoRevealPermissionHelpTile: When a player completes this tile's unboxing, their ownership of linked journals is raised to the selected level.
Setting.AutoGiveItemHelp: Automatically add the item to the player's inventory after unboxing.
Setting.ModeGachaDesc: Open a gacha pull interface linked to a specific pool.
